mechanism: Both phenelzine (MAOI) and St. John's Wort have serotonergic activity; concurrent use risks serotonin syndrome through additive monoamine potentiation and possible CYP3A4-mediated drug interactions.
action: Contraindicated combination - avoid concurrent use; allow 14-day washout after phenelzine discontinuation before starting St. John's Wort, or vice versa.
